mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases > 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) are declining, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and RSAFS declines.
